signal: Pelico raised $40M led by General Catalyst (total $72M) for its AI supply-chain orchestration platform, with 300% YoY revenue growth and a new North American base in Miami

email.body1:
Emily, saw Pelico raised $40M with General Catalyst and stood up a North American base in Miami on the back of 300 percent revenue growth.

Expanding into a new region that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Pelico off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Emily, quick follow-up for Pelico.

Opening North America, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover the new manufacturers in play. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Pelico needs in the new region this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Emily, last bit of proof for Pelico.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Pelico's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Emily, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a new region is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your North American motion? I will tailor it to Pelico either way.
